functions.name: AICollision
functions.summary: AI collision-state check. Returns 0 (no collision) immediately when the global session type dword_7C56A4 is not the qualifying mode (7). Otherwise verifies four consecutive wheel-contact entries (stride 296 from a2+2100): if any entry's dword is null or its byte at +64 is clear it returns 1. Returns 2 when the vehicle state at a2+15724 equals 2. In engine-wear mode 3 (dword_7CEA5C) it resolves the outcome through DriverSetupParamLookupByID on the setup parameter at a2+16444. Otherwise two probabilistic response checks (gated by byte flags this+0x340 and this+0x341, using divider this+0x35C and multiplier this+0x344) draw successive samples from the flt_8AAE74 trig-lookup table indexed by the incrementing byte counter dword_8AAE70 and map threshold crosses to result 1 or 2.

operations.description: Return 0 when the global session type dword_7C56A4 is not 7 (the qualifying-session mode); the whole collision check is skipped otherwise.
Iterate the four wheel-contact entries beginning at a2+2100 with stride 296: if any entry's first dword is null or its byte at +64 is clear (wheel missing/not in contact), return 1 immediately.
Return 2 when the vehicle state dword at a2+15724 equals 2 (a fixed collision-severity state).
In engine-wear mode 3 (dword_7CEA5C), resolve the outcome through DriverSetupParamLookupByID(a2, setup param at a2+16444): return 0 when the looked-up value is -1 or lower, otherwise return 2.

Primary probabilistic check when byte flag this+0x340 is set: compute threshold v7 = (speed float at a2+17616) * 0.0099999998 / (double)this+0x35C * a3, draw a sample from the flt_8AAE74 lookup at the byte-indexed position dword_8AAE70++ (post-increment), and set v3 = 1 when the sample is at or below the threshold.

Secondary probabilistic check when byte flag this+0x341 is set and v3 is not already 1: compute threshold v9 = (1.0 - (wear float at a2+17628) * 0.0099999998) / (double)this+0x35C * a3 * (float)this+0x344, draw the next sample from flt_8AAE74 via dword_8AAE70++, and return 2 when the sample is at or below the threshold.
Return v3, the accumulated outcome: 0 (no collision), 1 (wheel/missing or primary threshold crossed), or 2 (state-based or secondary threshold crossed).
Invoked from EngineFailureCheck (0x004BEC55).

functions.name: AIDriverSorting
functions.summary: AI driver position sorting. Iterates position slots 1..VehicleCount over the vehicle pointer array and, for each slot, finds the vehicle whose position field (+0x4060) matches the slot. For the driver a1, decides whether it should be placed ahead of the slot-holder: in a race session (session type 7) by lap count (+0x403C) then total time on finish line (+0x4098), otherwise by best lap (+0x409C). When a pass is warranted it swaps the two drivers' position values through ConditionalFieldSetter (a1 takes the other's position, the other driver's position is incremented) and stops further swaps for this call. Returns the session type.

operations.description: Capture session type dword_7C56A4 (also as v11) and vehicle count dword_5C329C (also as v3); read a1's own position at +16480 into v12; initialize swap flag v10=0, swap partner v4=0, and outer slot counter v13=1.
Guard: if vehicle count dword_5C329C < 1, return immediately with result = session type (nothing to sort).
Outer loop: advance the target position slot v13 (result = ++v13) from 1 through vehicle count v3; when v13 exceeds v3, return result (session type).
Inner loop: for v5 from 0 while v5 < v3, read the candidate vehicle v6 = dword_7C54F0[v5] from the vehicle pointer array.
Guard: read candidate position v7 at v6+16480; continue only when v7 equals the target slot v13.
Guard: if the candidate v6 is a1 itself, skip to the next outer slot.

Guard (race session): when session type == 7 and no swap has occurred yet (v10 == 0), compare lap counts at v6+16444 and a1+16444; if a1's lap count is greater, or equal with a1's total time at +16536 not below v6's +16536, a1 should pass the candidate.
Guard (non-race session): otherwise, when a1's best lap at +16540 is not below v6's best lap at +16540 and v6's best lap is >= 0.0, a1 should pass the candidate.

When a1 passes the candidate: mark swap performed (v10=1), remember the partner v4=v6, force the outer loop to end if a1's own position minus 1 equals v7, then write the swapped position values: ConditionalFieldSetter(a1+16436, v7) and ConditionalFieldSetter(v6+16436, oldPosition+1).

When a swap was already performed (v10==1) and the candidate differs from the remembered partner v4: update v4, call ConditionalFieldSetter(v6+16436, v7+1), and if a1's own position v12 equals the candidate's position, skip to the next outer slot.
Return result (session type dword_7C56A4) once the outer slot loop completes.

functions.name: AITickUpdate

Write the clamped race time into vehicle +16536 as a float.
Write vehicle +16568 = this[213] - flt_8ACF90 + v7 (time delta offset by the race-time offset global).
When the vehicle state at +16484 is not 3, force it to 1.
AIDriverSorting(v5): re-sort driver ordering after the lap/time update.

Case 7: call TimerCountdownWithStateTransition and store its low byte as v2, the function return value.

functions.name: TireBrushModelForceSolver
functions.summary: Per-frame tire force solver on the vehicle object: iterates 15 normalized slip-ratio samples, and for each sample accumulates brush-model longitudinal/lateral force contributions over the four per-wheel records (stride 248 bytes from base 13868) with load-transfer sign patterns, storing a per-wheel 15-entry force array. Then derives a corner-weight/average-load value from load-transfer mode, normalizes per-wheel vertical loads, applies wet/dry grip scaling (flag a2) to the 15-entry lookup table at 15424/15488, and finally runs a 15-iteration bisection solve that inverts a slope lookup (via sub_5895A2 with linear interpolation) to produce vertical-force/slip solutions written to an output array at 15616. Load-geometry normalization: v94 = 1.0 / (fabs(13964 + 13716 - 14212 - 14460) * 0.5) and v90 = 1.0 / (fabs(13708 - 13956 + 14204 - 14452) * 0.5), combining per-axle corner-weight geometry fields.
15-iteration outer loop over slip samples (counter v76): per-sample slip factor v74 = v76 * flt_7D0278 * 0.071428575.

Inner 4-wheel accumulation over the wheel record array at base 13868 (stride 62 dwords): reads the slip input at +72 per wheel, clamps it to the per-wheel cap, and accumulates v8; then v12 = v8 * the field at 16420, and precomputes v83 = v94 * v12 * 0.5 and v81 = v12 * v90 * 0.5.

Four load-transfer summation variants over the wheels (front/rear and left/right sign patterns), gated by the load-transfer mode field at 14772, producing the four per-wheel force accumulations v15, v20, v27, v34.
Store the four accumulated force samples into the per-wheel output arrays at bases 15488 and 15552 (and adjacent slots), advancing one sample per outer iteration.

Load-transfer mode selector on the field at 14772: mode 0 averages fields 14584 and 14336, mode 1 averages fields 14584, 14336, 14088 and 13840 (quarter), mode 2 averages fields 14088 and 13840; the result (halved or quartered) is stored to the field at 15680.

Corner-weight normalization over the wheel array at base 13840: picks front weight field 14896 or rear weight field 14916 by index, accumulates weight/load per wheel, then v51 = sum * the field at 13592 and stores it to the field at 15676.

Per-wheel vertical-load scratch array: v54 = field 14960 * 4096.0 - field 13588 * -9.8100004; for each wheel at base 13840, v98[i] = 0.0 when the wheel load is not positive, else v54 / load * the field at +40 (13880); the field at 15684 is seeded from the field at 14956.
Write the blended vertical load to the field at 15684: ((v98[3] + v98[2]) * 0.27500001 + (v98[1] + v98[0]) * 0.22499999) * 0.00024414062 + prior value.

Grip-mode branch on a2: wet path scales the field at 15676 by 0.92 and rescales all 15 entries of the lookup tables at base 15424 by 1.0 / field 15348 times 0.92/0.84 factors; dry path scales the field at 15676 by flt_7D020C and multiplies the same table entries by flt_7D0230, flt_7D0254 and 0.97000003.

15-iteration vertical-force bisection solve (counter v60, output pointer at base 15616): per sample v96 = v77 * v87 * 0.071428575, then an inner bisection loop over v75 starting at 128.0 with step v82 halved each pass, breaking when v82 falls below 0.4.
Per-iteration load math inside the bisection: v86 = v75 * field 13588 * v75 * v96 and v62 = v75 * v75 * field 14960 - (v75 * v75 * 0.0 - 9.8100004) * field 13588.

Slope lookup and interpolation: v63 = v62 * field 15420 and v66 = v62 * field 15484; after sub_5895A2 the integer parts are clamped to 0..13 and linearly interpolated between the table pairs at bases 15424 and 15488; the maximum of the two interpolated values is kept.

Final interpolation of the solved value: v71 = v84 - v97; when zero, keep v75, otherwise v72 = (v84 - 1.0) / v71 clamped to [-1.0, 2.0] giving v73 = v72 * (v95 - v75) + v75 (or the lower-clamped variant); clamp v73 >= 0 and store into the output array at base 15616.

functions.name: FuelConsumptionAndWear

Sum the per-tire wear accumulators over 4 wheels (this[3444], stride 62) into a single wear total.
Grip decay factor = 1.0 - wearTotal * 0.2325.

For each of 4 wheels: if the per-wheel wear source is positive, decrement tire wear level (this[3468]) by gripFactor * wearSource * wear-rate factor (this[3469]) * tireWearMultiplier (dword_7D0C60) * dt, then clamp the wear level at a minimum of 0.75.

Engine failure (case 0): write error code 1 to the error register (obj+0x4068) if not already set.
If engine RPM (this[3685]) is below 50% of the RPM limit (this[3686]), suppress the failure by resetting the countdown to 0.

On gearbox failure, scale one of the two gearbox wear factors (this[3724] or this[3729], chosen by noise draw from flt_8AB274[dword_8AAE70++]) by 0.03125.
Complete gearbox failure: set failure mode state (this[3928]) = 2 and post the event via sub_41AC50(object, 1).
Puncture failure (case 2): write error code 2 to the error register (obj+0x4068) if not already set.
